author: sonnet
label: seeded-07r-01
changes: Added a summary and a terms block before the diagram, defining token, reset_tokens, burned, queue/worker and the generic message.
Expanded the diagram so each flow shows its branches: unknown address, rate limit, expired link, rejected password, and the transaction at set-password.
Replaced one-line notes with notes that say why: the generic response, rate limit counted from reset_tokens rows, new link burns old ones, token checked twice, password checked before burn.
Added the data design: a reset_tokens table with hash, created, expiry and used time; no separate counter.
Replaced 'usual retries' with the actual behaviour: 3 retries, then silent drop, and what that means for the user.
Added a failure section covering mail failure, database error and failure of the confirmation email.
Added open questions: no alert on dropped reset email, and one expired-page message for all dead links.

Restored brief facts the first draft lacked: 30-minute expiry, logout on every device including the current one, no auto-login, the exact generic message, and link staying usable after a rejected password.
Cut nothing from the original notes; they are merged into the diagram and notes.
